fact: Who founded The Biological Computing Co.? Alex Ksendzovsky and Jon Pomeraniec
quote: Founded by the neurosurgeon-scientists Alex Ksendzovsky, CEO, and Jon Pomeraniec, COO.

fact: What was The Biological Computing Co. formerly called? Biological Black Box
quote: The company was formerly called Biological Black Box.

fact: Which firm led The Biological Computing Co.'s $25M seed round in 2026? Primary
quote: A $25M seed led by Primary, February 2026, joined by Builders VC, Refactor Capital, Wonder Ventures, E1 Ventures, Proximity and Tusk Ventures.

fact: Where did The Biological Computing Co. open its flagship lab? Mission Bay, San Francisco
quote: With its seed round it opened a flagship lab in Mission Bay, San Francisco.

fact: Into what does The Biological Computing Co. encode data before reading the responses into AI models? Living neurons
quote: Data is encoded into living neurons, the neurons' responses are recorded, and those responses are mapped onto AI models.

fact: Which Melbourne company in the same field sells the CL1 biological computer? Cortical Labs
quote: Do not confuse this company with Cortical Labs, a Melbourne company in the same space that sells a $35,000 commercial biological computer, the CL1, and has deployed units at the National University of Singapore and in a Melbourne data centre.

fact: Claimed text-to-video model ~80% cheaper and 5x faster (unverified company claim)
quote: The company has claimed a text-to-video model about 80% cheaper and five times faster as a result.
